decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, along with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Angrath's Rampage, to apply early pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to seal the game. Additionally, the deck has some flexibility with cards like Blood Moon and Terminate to handle different matchups. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy while also providing the necessary colors for the spells in the deck.

The deck utilizes a diverse toolbox of creatures to create powerful synergy and combos, supported by cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Chord of Calling. The strategy focuses on generating value through sacrificing and recurring creatures, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, with lands like Blooming Marsh and Verdant Catacombs. Agatha's Soul Cauldron provides additional graveyard interaction, while cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse offer strong late-game threats. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through careful creature selection and timing.

The strategy of this deck revolves around utilizing the creatures toolbox to assemble combos with cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Agatha's Soul Cauldron. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Orcish Bowmasters to tutor for specific creatures, the deck aims to create strong synergies and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Nurturing Peatland allow for card advantage and flexibility in different game states. Overall, the deck focuses on generating incremental advantages and leveraging the versatility of its creature toolbox to control the battlefield and secure victory.

This deck focuses on using powerful control spells and card advantage to outmaneuver the opponent. It utilizes cards like Teferi, Narset, and Supreme Verdict to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The key card, The One Ring, provides a win condition that can generate card advantage and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells and counterspells to deal with threats efficiently. By controlling the game state and generating card advantage, this deck aims to grind out victories through careful planning and resource management.

This mono black aggro deck focuses on utilizing disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to control the opponent's hand, while also applying pressure with efficient creatures like Grief and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and card advantage engines like The Rack and Urza's Saga to maintain a strong board presence. The main strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily chipping away at their life total with a combination of aggressive creatures and versatile removal spells.

This deck aims to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, then use spells like Faithful Mending and Goryo's Vengeance to bring them back onto the battlefield for a game-winning combo. The deck also utilizes cards like Ephemerate and Fallaji Archaeologist to manipulate the graveyard and protect its key creatures. With efficient removal spells like Prismatic Ending and Solitude, the deck can control the board while setting up its combo. The inclusion of Thoughtseize allows for disruption against opponent's game plan and ensures a smoother path to victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of discard spells and efficient removal. The main strategy revolves around putting pressure on the opponent with early creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief, while disrupting their hand and board with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The inclusion of powerful cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse allows for additional value and big plays to close out games in a decisive manner.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on dealing quick, efficient damage to the opponent while disrupting their resources with cards like Grief and Thoughtseize. The deck employs a mix of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters, along with removal spells such as Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt. Additionally, the deck utilizes graveyard interaction with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse ensures the deck can close out games quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game using the UrzaTron lands to generate massive amounts of mana and play powerful threats like Wurmcoil Engine and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon. The deck also utilizes cards like Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying to search for the UrzaTron lands quickly. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like All Is Dust and Dismember to deal with opposing threats, as well as artifacts like Karn, the Great Creator and Oblivion Stone for added control. The inclusion of Boseiju, Who Endures and Cityscape Leveler provides additional utility and versatility in different situations.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's hand with discard spells like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters to put pressure on your opponent. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats, as well as a few powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to close out the game quickly. Additionally, Undying Evil and Not Dead After All provide recursion and resilience to keep your threats alive and threatening.

This deck focuses on cycling through cards and manipulating the graveyard in order to cast Living End and return a large number of creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield. By using cards like Subtlety, Architects of Will, Shardless Agent, and Generous Ent to manipulate the top of the deck and cycle through cards quickly, the deck aims to set up a powerful Living End play to overwhelm the opponent with a massive board presence. The deck also includes cards like Grief and Waker of Waves to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building towards the Living End combo.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by using powerful removal spells like Damnation and Fatal Push, while also disrupting your opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize. The deck also aims to generate value with cards like The One Ring and Karn, the Great Creator. Additionally, the deck has ways to generate extra mana with Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Cabal Coffers, allowing you to play your spells more efficiently. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast your opponent in a long game.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through counterspells and removal spells while utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils to disrupt their game plan. The key card is The One Ring, which provides card advantage and can be used to protect your own threats. The deck also includes a mix of lands to ensure consistent mana production and access to different colors of mana. The goal is to outvalue the opponent and eventually overwhelm them with powerful spells and card advantage.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's plans through hand disruption and removal spells, while also controlling the battlefield with powerful creatures like Karn, the Great Creator and Sheoldred's Edict. The deck also utilizes mana acceleration with cards like Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to ramp into bigger threats like The One Ring. With a combination of disruption, removal, and powerful threats, this deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent in a long-term match.

This deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It utilizes toolbox creatures like Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to control the board, while also utilizing combo pieces like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to create powerful synergies. The deck also includes cards like Chord of Calling and Agatha's Soul Cauldron to tutor for specific creatures and maintain card advantage. The combination of disruptive creatures and combo pieces allows for a versatile and powerful strategy in the Modern format.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly gain life through the Martyr of Sands ability, while also using various cards to control the board and protect your life total. This aggressive strategy aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of creatures, removal spells, and life gain effects, ultimately allowing you to outlast your opponent and secure victory. By efficiently managing your resources and utilizing key cards like Reprieve and Ranger-Captain of Eos, you can maintain a strong board presence and pressure your opponent into submission.
